thread:
alex_cs: Quick sync: Nebula reserved pool bring-up Thurs. Need a compact preflight focused on quota caps, autoscale sensitivity, and a priming plan. Who can own what? :clipboard:

jordan_sre: I can own autoscale and perf dashboards. What's the steady and burst profile for live traffic?
maria_pm: Nebula expects ~650 RPS steady for search, intermittent bursts to ~1800-2k for 45-90s. Region eu-west-1, reserved pool D. SLA target p99 < 300ms.
sam_ml: Model is gpt-big-8k. Important: KV cache priming changes latency a lot. We'll run cold/hot runs. Also prepare a small eval set (50 samples) for a quick quality gate.
jordan_sre: Proposed soft quotas: concurrency 320, token/sec 260k. Runbook: 1) priming loop 2) steady smoke 3) burst ramp to 2k 4) autoscale validation 5) fallback to hosted variant 6) quality gate.
alex_cs: Ops wants a runnable command snippet in case SRE is overloaded. Can you paste k6 + priming examples?
jordan_sre: k6 snippet (from eu-west bastion): `k6 run --vus 100 --duration 30s script.js` then ramp to 2000 over 30s, hold 75s. Adjust seeds for concurrency.
sam_ml: Priming example: `while read p; do curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -d "$p" >/dev/null; done < prime_prefixes.txt` run twice. Eval harness will compare token-level score vs baseline and return PASS/FAIL.
eng-sre-bot: [scheduled-test] nebula-compact-preflight: job 1745559999 scheduled Thu 08:30-10:00 UTC in eu-west-1.
maria_pm: Nebula prefers morning. We'll do a 08:30 quick warmup, main ramp at 09:15.
jordan_sre: Ownership timeline: 08:30 warmup (sam_ml + alex_cs), 09:15 ramp (jordan_sre + eng-sre), 09:45 fallback & failover test (eng-sre), 09:55 quality gate (sam_ml).
alex_cs: Quota guardrails: start conservative and document escalation to procurement. Also capture renewal health note for Nebula.
sam_ml: I'll automate the quality gate; if delta > threshold, the run aborts and we revert traffic.
jordan_sre: Alerting rules: error rate >0.5% or p99 > 400ms -> pause and fallback. We'll add a dashboard snapshot step.
alex_cs: Action list: jordan_sre -> k6 + perf runbook (due Wed EOD), sam_ml -> priming script + eval set, maria_pm -> confirm stakeholders & sign-off, eng-sre-bot -> create job + alerts.
eng-sre-bot: [reminder] nebula-compact-preflight in 2 days: job 1745559999.
maria_pm: Procurement is looped; they authorized base commit. Document the post-go-live concurrency bump process.
eng-sre-bot: [completed] nebula-compact-preflight job 1745559999 executed. Results uploaded to /artifacts/1745559999.
jordan_sre: Run recap: peak RPS 1925, p95 78ms, p99 160ms, errors 0.09%. Autoscale scaled from 1->4 nodes in ~42s. Fallback exercised successfully.
sam_ml: Quality gate: 50-sample set passed. No significant divergence from baseline.
alex_cs: Thanks team. I'll compile the handoff doc, include the onboarding checklist and renewal health summary to share with Nebula PM. :tada:
